tools.name: geocode_addresses
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to geocode addresses, convert addresses to latitude and longitude, or do a census tract lookup with a downloadable Excel and CSV file. US addresses only; up to 1,000 rows and 200,000 characters. Do not use for driving directions or addresses outside US coverage.

tools.name: find_address_districts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants congressional district by address, state legislative district by address, or census tract by address with downloadable Excel and CSV files. US addresses only; up to 100 rows and 200,000 characters. Do not use for elected representative names or contact details.
